mapper.sql: id, document_id, file_id, revision, tenant_id, creator_id, created_time, status_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bt_dc_document_file_log ( id, document_id, file_id, revision, tenant_id, creator_id, created_time, status_cd ) VALUES ( #{log.id}, #{log.documentId}, #{log.fileId}, #{log.revision}, #{log.tenantId}, #{log.creatorId}, , #{log.statusCd} )
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.document_id, l.file_id, l.revision, l.tenant_id, l.creator_id, l.created_time, l.status_cd, d.document_name AS documentName, d.content_source AS contentSource, f.file_name AS fileName, u.real_name AS userName FROM bt_dc_document_file_log l LEFT JOIN bt_dc_document d ON d.document_id = l.document_id AND d.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND d.status_cd = '00A' LEFT JOIN bt_file f ON f.file_id = l.file_id AND f.status_cd = '00A' LEFT JOIN bt_user u ON u.user_id = l.creator_id WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.status_cd = '00A'

SELECT l.id, l.document_id, l.file_id, l.revision, l.tenant_id, l.creator_id, l.created_time, l.status_cd, d.document_name AS documentName, d.content_source AS contentSource, f.file_name AS fileName, u.real_name AS userName FROM bt_dc_document_file_log l LEFT JOIN bt_dc_document d ON d.document_id = l.document_id AND d.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND d.status_cd = '00A' LEFT JOIN bt_file f ON f.file_id = l.file_id AND f.status_cd = '00A' LEFT JOIN bt_user u ON u.user_id = l.creator_id WHERE l.document_id = #{documentId} AND l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.status_cd = '00A' ORDER BY l.created_time DESC
